title: Understanding Instance-Level Impact of Fairness Constraints

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring demographic parity violations (difference in acceptance rates between male and female groups) on the Adult census dataset for income prediction and the CelebA dataset for image classification while pruning influential training examples based on fairness constraints.

Evaluating demographic parity violations (difference in acceptance rates) on the Jigsaw Comment Toxicity Classification dataset, using race as the sensitive attribute to assess the impact of removing influential text examples on model fairness.
